neighbours.label: ' Canada' as the name of the historical colonial unit 'Province of Canada' (1841-1867); modern-day Canada or other provinces stay low
fire: After the Act of Union, the legislature of the Province of Canada met in Kingston.
John A. Macdonald served in the assembly of the Province of Canada before Confederation.
In 1849 rioters burned the parliament building of the Province of Canada in Montreal.
The railway was chartered by the Province of Canada in the 1850s.
Historians date the Province of Canada from 1841 to 1867.
Upper and Lower Canada were joined into the Province of Canada by the British.
Coins issued by the Province of Canada are now prized by collectors.
The capital of the Province of Canada moved several times before Ottawa was chosen.
quiet: After the election, the legislature of Ontario met in Toronto.
John A. Macdonald is remembered as Canada's first prime minister.
In 1849 rioters burned the parliament building in Montreal.
The railway was chartered by the colony of Victoria in the 1850s.
Historians date the gold rush in British Columbia to 1858.
Many skiers travel to western Canada every winter.
Coins issued by the Royal Canadian Mint are now prized by collectors.
The capital of Australia moved from Melbourne before Canberra was chosen.
